# ✨ Almighty's Choice

This is a modern pack with numerous quality-of-life modifications.
Along side these, some tech-orientated and weapon mods are sprinkled in to change the game up enough to feel fresh to me.

## 💡 Featuring

- QoL improvements
- Uniquely distinct technology mods
- More biomes to explore
- Further weapons to craft
- Base security
- Rich Presence

## 🤔 Why?

This year I was looking for a tech pack to play, on a modern version with all the creature comforts I have grown used to. Sadly, not a single pack existed that I felt kept the balance between vanilla and super ott. This is why Almighty's Choice exists.
